# Gogotan, LLC

> Turnkey staffing firm based in Colorado with more than ten years of staffing experience. Gogotan recruits, employs, and manages a client's workforce (as W-2 employees or 1099 contractors) and handles payroll, HR, and compliance. It is not a recruitment agency: staff work through Gogotan, and the client gets one contract and one invoice.

Contact: admin@gogotanstaff.com
Website: https://gogotanstaff.com/

## Services

- Temporary staffing: seasonal surges, special events, coverage gaps, short-term projects
- Permanent staffing: long-term roles filled and employed through Gogotan
- Fractional management: experienced managers embedded part-time
- Coaching: coaches placed inside organizations, and staff for coaching businesses
- Consulting: subject-matter experts for defined problems, directly or as staffing for consulting firms
- Government contracting support: staff for contractors performing on government contracts and for companies bidding on them
- IT and AI services: IT support, systems and network roles, AI-focused specialists

## Industries

Restaurant and food service; beverage and alcohol service; cleaning and janitorial; event management; coaching and consulting; government contracting; IT and AI services; other service-sector work on request.

## How it works

1. The client describes roles, schedules, duration, and skills; scope goes into one contract.
2. Gogotan recruits and screens, then brings people on as W-2 employees or 1099 contractors.
3. The team works for the client; payroll, HR, and administration stay with Gogotan.
